world_constraints: One image per request; no multi-panel collage or embedded borders.
Compose for the fixed holder. Do not letterbox or paste the old wide image.
Preserve character faces, outfits, heraldry, weapons, metal colours and scene counts.
Keep essential faces, bodies and weapons inside the visible crop-safe area and outside lettering zones.
No unsupported new lore, extra Type C suits, extra capital ships or invented character names.

Floating-island backgrounds must have deliberately varied asymmetric silhouettes, geology, heights, scale and land use. Mix broad fractured mesas, thin tilted slabs, split rock spires and bare rubble, with open sky between them. Some fragments are uninhabited or vegetated; not every island carries an identical castle. Never tile, mirror or repeat the same inverted-cone island/city silhouette. Preserve a named location’s defining geography when changing camera angle.

Rovan owns FOUR capital ships: wedge-prowed Argonaut and THREE crimson repainted round-prowed Bastion prizes. Oram is now under siege, not conquered. Trading convoys are smaller transport ships, not extra capitals. City standards remain Auric GOLD/NAVY; fleet standards Veymarch CRIMSON/SILVER. Show only ships required by the shot.
Oram remains the capital of Auric Reach, not a new duchy. Siege, not victory or surrender.
Only four owned CAPITAL ships. Smaller supply traders are a separate transport class and only appear when requested.
Maintain spatial ownership: Veymarch crimson/SILVER ships outside, Auric GOLD/NAVY city inside.
Unique broad agricultural city geography, varied low districts, irregular cliff shelves and farmland. Never tile identical conical castle islands.

All airborne vessels are rigid mechanical bronze/metal Zeppelin-like ships. ANY wooden sailing boats or cloth sails seen in an old scene reference are obsolete errors: REPLACE them with small bronze Zeppelin commuter hulls, keeping background positions.

prompt:
PURPOSE: Regenerate ONE comic illustration for FIXED holder 400.00 by 350.00 logical pixels, aspect 1.1429:1. NEAR SQUARE. Requested output 1088x960. Do NOT resize or redesign the holder. Paint a NEW composition for it, not a framed photo.

SCENE: A clear near-square view of exactly THREE SMALLER bronze mechanical TRADING zeppelins on a two-way supply route: two loaded convoy ships head right toward the distant siege haze outside Oram, one returning trader heads left with visibly opposite prow direction. Large external ore/cargo holds, grain sacks and ammunition crates secured to metal racks; no sails or wooden boats. NO capital ships in this close supply-route shot. Tiny crimson/silver Veymarch pennants. New Frontier’s low terraced industrial harbour recedes left; a faint farmland shelf on right hints Oram beyond the siege line. Ships unload at the friendly siege lines OUTSIDE Oram, not inside the enemy city. Angular bare rubble and one flat forested slab, ample open sky, no tiled castles.
CAMERA: Use a clear, tightly composed shot with the important action filling the aperture; do not copy the old wide framing.

STYLE: Magneton graphic novel: painted ink, tactile bronze machinery, silver Type C, crimson Veymarch cloth, navy/gold Auric Reach uniforms; atmospheric floating islands. Consistent with supplied scene references, not photorealistic.
